checklist.title: Color tokens
checklist.description: paper / ink / accent / hairline / surface / canvas + the *semantic* additions we're missing: danger, warn, ok, live, preview, muted, overlay-scrim, focus-ring

checklist.title: Dark mode
checklist.description: Booth operators run in dark rooms. Either a full dark palette or a "booth mode" inversion. Decide now — it changes every component.

checklist.title: Type scale
checklist.description: display / h1 / h2 / h3 / body / body-sm / label / mono / scripture serif. Sizes, weights, line-heights, letter-spacing. Current UI uses uppercase-tracked labels everywhere — decide if that survives.

checklist.title: Spacing scale
checklist.description: 4px base: 1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16,24 — plus the three *density modes* below

checklist.title: Density modes
checklist.description: comfortable (library screens) / compact (Live surface) / touch (if a tablet/stage-display client is ever built)

checklist.title: Radius scale
checklist.description: none / sm / md / lg / pill / full

checklist.title: Elevation
checklist.description: flat / hairline / raised / floating / modal — currently everything is hairline-only

checklist.title: Motion tokens
checklist.description: durations (instant 80 / fast 140 / base 220 / slow 400), easings, and a prefers-reduced-motion path. Live-surface transitions must never exceed ~150ms.

checklist.title: Z-index ladder
checklist.description: base → sticky header → popover → drawer → modal → toast → tour spotlight → output overlay

checklist.title: Icon set
checklist.description: ~60 icons: play, stop, mic, mic-off, eye, eye-off, monitor, monitor-x, chevrons, plus, trash, edit, drag-handle, search, filter, check, x, alert, info, refresh, download, upload, cloud, cloud-off, qr, book, music, image, palette, calendar, user, settings, keyboard, wifi, wifi-off, lock, external-link, copy, more-horizontal, grid, list, arrow-up/down/left/right, skip-forward/back, clock, timer, sparkle (AI), waveform, projector, layers, link, unlink, star, flag, undo

checklist.title: Focus & keyboard
checklist.description: visible focus ring spec, tab order rules, roving tabindex for lists/grids

checklist.title: Global shortcut map
checklist.description: the whole keybinding table (see S-01 notes) — a design artifact, not just code

checklist.title: Sound/haptics
checklist.description: optional: a soft confirm tick on GO LIVE. Decide yes/no.

checklist.title: Empty/loading/error voice
checklist.description: the copy rules — how the app talks when it has nothing to show

checklist.title: Seasonal theming hooks
checklist.description: which tokens are allowed to shift for Advent/Lent/Easter/Christmas without breaking contrast

checklist.title: Button
checklist.description: variants: solid, outline, text, ghost, danger, live (the red/black go-live volume); sizes: xs/sm/md/lg/xl; states: default, hover, active, focus, disabled, loading; optional leading/trailing icon; full-width

checklist.title: IconButton
checklist.description: square/circle, all Button variants, requires aria-label, tooltip-on-hover built in

checklist.title: SplitButton
checklist.description: primary action + dropdown of variants (e.g. GO LIVE ▾ → "go live & hold")

checklist.title: TextInput
checklist.description: sizes, prefix/suffix slots, invalid state, char counter

checklist.title: NumberInput
checklist.description: stepper buttons, min/max/step, unit suffix (ms, %, sec)

checklist.title: PasswordInput
checklist.description: reveal toggle, "saved" masked state for API keys

checklist.title: SearchInput
checklist.description: leading icon, clear button, Kbd shortcut hint, debounce

checklist.title: Combobox
